entries.label: 2026 federal basic personal amount (maximum)
entries.notes: Credit value = $16,452 x 14% = $2,303.28. Reduces to $14,829 base at net income above $258,482 (phase-down from $181,440).
entries.source_note: CRA; verified 2026-09-27 via Fidelity, Waypoint Budget, Lifemoney, money.ca.

entries.label: 2026 provincial/territorial basic personal amounts
entries.notes: Provincial credits = BPA x lowest provincial rate. PE raised its BPA to $15,000 (announced 2026); NS indexed 1.6%; BC indexed; AB capped 2%; QC indexed 2.05%; MB and PE not indexed for 2026 (PE 15k figure verified via income-tax-estimator research); NL indexed 1.1%; territories indexed.
entries.source_note: KPMG federal/provincial personal-tax tables (current as of June 30, 2026), cross-checked vs income-tax-estimator research (Lifemoney, Waypoint Budget, TurboTax). Primary ministry pages not individually re-pulled this run - January 2027 sweep should cross-check against ministry tables.
